<thought>Search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic template that breaks an aliphatic hydroxyl (functional group “aliphatic hydroxyls”) and forms an alkyl halide (functional group “alkyl halide”). Using a simple molecule containing an alkyl halide (e.g., “CF”) satisfies the forward‑reaction criteria.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CF",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["alkyl halide"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
